hero.subtitle: Where Palestinian heritage meets precision craft — handcrafted furniture and bespoke woodwork from the heart of Nablus.

about.label: Our Story
about.title:
Passion for Wood, 
Perfection in Craft
about.p1: For over 13 years, Hollywood Furniture & Woodworking has been transforming raw timber into living art. Founded by master craftsman Muath Domidi, our workshop in Howwara, Nablus blends Palestinian woodworking heritage with contemporary design sensibilities.
about.p2: Every piece we create is a collaboration between artisan and client — beginning with a conversation, moving through careful material selection, and culminating in a finished work that outlasts trends.

owner.label: Meet the Craftsman
owner.title: Muath Domidi
owner.subtitle: Master Woodworker & Founder
owner.p1: With 13 years of dedicated craftsmanship, Muath Domidi has built Hollywood Furniture into one of Palestine's most trusted furniture workshops. Based in Howwara, Nablus, he combines traditional Palestinian woodworking techniques with modern precision.
owner.p2: Every piece that leaves the workshop bears Muath's personal commitment to quality — from the first sketch to the final polish. His passion for wood is not just a profession, it's a legacy.

services.label: What We Do
services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: From a single statement chair to a complete interior fit-out — we bring your vision to life with uncompromising attention to detail.

custom.title: Custom Furniture
custom.desc: Bespoke pieces designed and built to your exact specifications — dining tables, bedroom sets, living room furniture, and more.

kitchen.title: Kitchen Cabinets
kitchen.desc: Precision-fitted kitchen cabinetry crafted from premium hardwoods and engineered timbers, built to last a lifetime.

restoration.title: Wood Restoration
restoration.desc: Breathing new life into antique and heirloom pieces — careful repair, refinishing, and structural restoration.

interior.title: Interior Woodwork
interior.desc: Wall paneling, ceiling treatments, staircases, doors, and architectural millwork that transforms interior spaces.

outdoor.title: Outdoor Furniture
outdoor.desc: Weather-resistant outdoor sets crafted from teak, cedar, and hardwoods — built for beauty and longevity.

process.label: How We Work
process.title: Our Process
process.subtitle: From first conversation to final delivery — a seamless journey built on trust and transparency.

consultation.title: Consultation & Design
consultation.desc: We begin with a detailed consultation to understand your vision, space, and requirements. Our designers then create technical drawings and 3D renders for your approval.

materials.title: Material Selection
materials.desc: We source premium timbers and materials from trusted suppliers. You're welcome to visit our workshop to hand-pick the wood for your piece.

crafting.title: Crafting & Assembly
crafting.desc: Our master craftsmen bring your design to life using traditional joinery techniques combined with modern precision tooling.

delivery.title: Delivery & Installation
delivery.desc: We deliver and professionally install every piece, ensuring a perfect fit. We don't leave until you're completely satisfied.
